sections.text:
Bases only, no games - 7pm start.
4 bases, 20 min each:
• Fire lighting - car park
• Kelly kettle / Billy can on the stone table in the walkway - reheat pre-cooked pasta, add sauce (and eat it)
• Light bulb changing, plus something else - maybe aeroplane making
• Sewing a badge onto a jumper (Chris)

The fireman is being invited.
